title: EA SPORTS™ presents Beckham, Zidane and Zlatan in conversation for the first time.
summary: Three global football legends. One exclusive conversation. Only on EA SPORTS YouTube and Spotify.
body_markdown:
### An unprecedented conversation.


**EA SPORTS™ Presents Icons of Football** is now available to watch and listen to on[EA SPORTS YouTube](https://youtu.be/sKFhK0z1aCw) and[Spotify.](https://open.spotify.com/episode/0tDQAouAEGl6Kh0nT5B2DJ) For the first time ever, **David Beckham, Zinédine Zidane, and Zlatan Ibrahimović come together** for an exclusive conversation sharing the stories, perspectives and reflections that shaped three of football's most iconic careers.


From Beckham on what separates great players from all-time greats, to Zidane speaking on coaching and competing on football's biggest stages, to Zlatan sharing the power of football to connect people worldwide, the conversation offers fans a rare opportunity to hear three legends reflect on the moments that defined their careers the next generation of stars and what continues to make football the world's game.


**Conversation Highlights**


- Zidane on handling pressure: "The harder the game, the more significant the game was, the less I felt pressure."
- Beckham on what separates great players from all-time greats: "You become one of the greats by consistency... You have to consistently be great to be great."
- Zlatan on the importance of discipline even if you’re talented: "If you don't have discipline, you will not arrive."


### Where Football's Biggest Voices Come Together


EA SPORTS™ Presents Icons of Football **was recorded at** EA SPORTS™ Presents House of Football with Sports Illustrated**, an exclusive gathering in New York that brought together athletes, celebrities, creators, and members of the global football community during one of the biggest weekends in sport.


EA SPORTS helps fans connect with football in new ways every day. Through experiences like EA SPORTS Presents House of Football and Icons of Football we’re bringing fans closer to the stories, moments, and athletes that continue to inspire football culture around the world.


### Watch Icons of Football


EA SPORTS™ Presents Icons of Football is now available on EA SPORTS[YouTube](https://youtu.be/sKFhK0z1aCw) and[Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/0tDQAouAEGl6Kh0nT5B2DJ) . Don’t miss the conversation between Beckham, Zidane, and Zlatan!
